The stationary source and regulated substances handled:
The Tooele site is a railcar storage facility and a short line railroad serving the neighboring industrial park. The site storage operations include Butane and Propane railcar receipt, temporary storage and movement. The process is limited to railcar movement and storage only; there are no loading or transloading activities at the facility.
The facility has the capability to store 150 railcars but limits the capacity to 120 to allow for movement of the cars. A loaded railcar typically will contain ~ 28,000 gallons of material.   The listed RMP flammables are Butane and Propane. Both chemicals are also PSM covered flammables. There are no RMP or PSM covered toxics at the facility.
The general accidental release prevention program and chemical-specific prevention steps:
Savage has implemented a combined Process Safety and Risk Management Program in line with the requirements under both RMP Program Level 3 and OSHA PSM. We have a comprehensive PSM/RMP Manual that outlines our commitment and compliance with each of the prevention program elements, emergency planning and response, hazard assessment, 5-year accident history, and submittal of the Risk Management Plan.
At the core of our PSM/RMP Program, the site team completed an initial Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) to identify potential hazards associated with the movement and storage of flammable chemicals and evaluate the risk and adequacy of the engineered and administrative safeguards in place. We also have an Inspection, Testing and Preventative Maintenance program in place to prevent mechanical failures of our covered equipment and safeguards identified in the PHA.

Planned changes to improve safety:
Our facility continually evaluates and implements recommendations and corrective actions resulting from process safety activities such as process hazard analyses, incident investigations and compliance audits. Savage also fosters a reporting culture and shares lessons learned across our organization.
The Tooele site is a new facility designed in accordance with the appropriate codes and standards to protect our workers, the community and the environment. Any future changes to the facility will be reviewed and implemented through the Management of Change process.
